encounter: P12 play_order 143, E0169 TRAINER_ALEXIA (Petalburg Gym room 6 - the berserkers), cap 42
availability_audit: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27; cap 42 until Norman's badge at the end of the Gym. No Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map walked by C26. Lucarionite stone-window 14; Mega Ring from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources excluded. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species.
plan: All six of Alexia's are physical attackers and three of them are on a self-inflicted status clock. The dossier's crack list is burst before the Orbs pay, deny priority, Taunt the setup, and remember the clock. Two structural answers are used here rather than one. First, Incineroar's Knock Off removes a Toxic Orb or Flame Orb BEFORE it activates, which deletes Toxic Boost or Guts for that battler entirely - this is the highest-value single action available against this room and it is why Incineroar is in the party. Second, Aegislash and Sableye are both immune to Normal AND Fighting, and crucially NO member of Alexia's six has Scrappy, unlike Berke's and Mary's rooms - so Facade, Body Slam, Extreme Speed, Quick Attack and Close Combat are all 0x against them. I want to be explicit that this is honest counterplay rather than the stall I fell into at play_order 138: Alexia's room carries Crunch, Knock Off, Waterfall, Aqua Jet, Brave Bird, Headlong Rush, Seed Bomb and U-turn, so it has real answers to a Ghost and I expect to have to fight. Sacred Sword and Foul Play are the setup answers: Sacred Sword ignores the target's Defense boosts from Curse, and Foul Play uses the target's own Attack, so Belly Drum and Swords Dance make it stronger. Declared in advance: Ursaluna's Bulletproof blocks ball and bomb moves, so Amoonguss's Sludge Bomb is a dead move against that slot specifically.
